title: Per-tenant audit retention profiles and KMS region delegator
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Add per-tenant audit retention profiles (default, strict, minimal) and a KMS-region delegator shim to ensure keys are used in tenant-authorized regions. Administrators can now configure audit retention per-tenant via the Console/API, and operators can opt into a soft-mode to gradually enforce region pinning.
description: Motivation: customers have requested granular audit retention controls plus a safe path to enforce KMS region pinning without mass disruption. This PR introduces two complementary features: 1) per-tenant audit retention profiles with RBAC guards so only org-admins can change retention; 2) a KMS-region-delegator middleware that selects/requests region-anchored CMKs on behalf of tenant requests and emits enriched audit events about region decisions. Changes are backwards-compatible by default: tenants inherit the global retention profile until explicitly configured. A `--audit-retention-migrate` CLI helper is provided to preview the impact before enabling per-tenant overrides. Migration notes: we add a default "strict-90d" profile applied automatically to new tenants; existing tenants keep previous global retention until a migration run. The KMS delegator supports soft-mode (non-blocking) which logs region mismatches and adds an audit tag (audit.region_conflict=true) but does not fail the request; full enforcement mode will be gated behind a feature flag and require tenant consent and operator rollout. Security considerations: configuration endpoints are protected by RBAC v2 checks (new policy predicates: "audit.retention.update" and "kms.region.delegate"); KMS usage now records a provenance header and a signed Delegation-Token when region selection crosses operator-managed zones. This PR includes unit and integration tests for decision matrix, a lightweight telemetry hook for Console visibility, and a short e2e that exercises migration CLI. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-1124; [x] API + Console changes; [x] RBAC v2 policy rules + OPA test harness; [x] migration CLI; [x] telemetry & alerts for soft-mode; [x] docs PR queued. Related work: PM-998 (product requirements), SUP-442 (customer support request).

review_comments: Carlos Mendes: Overall approach looks sound. Two asks: (1) can we add an explicit audit event when retention is changed via the migration CLI? (2) ensure the delegator doesn't add latency for cached CMK lookups.
Priya Nair: Reply - added audit event on migration apply and introduced an LRU cache around CMK lookup with 30s TTL in middleware; measured median p95 impact < 3ms in local perf tests.
Asha Gupta: Please add an OPA unit test for a role that should NOT be allowed to change retention (service-operator role). Also check the API error codes for 403 vs 404 semantics.
Priya Nair: Added OPA test fixtures and fixed error return to consistently return 403 when RBAC denies. Updated tests to reflect this.
Liam O'Connor: Security-scan flagged use of RSA-2048 in token signer library; recommend RSA-3072 or ECDSA. Also request a short design note about token rotation.
Priya Nair: Switched token signer to ECDSA-P256 and added rotation notes to docs + automated rotation job scaffold in pkg/kms/delegator/rotation.go (disabled by default).
Carlos Mendes: Approving after changes look good.
